description: This file contains utility functions and a class (`ConnectorUtils`) for managing connectors in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM environment. It handles loading, saving, and configuring external connector sources, including retrieving connector details, managing display configurations, handling language files, installing/uninstalling sources, and modifying metadata related to connectors.

classes.name: ConnectorUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage, retrieve, and modify connector sources, configurations, and related metadata within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: sources_sort_function
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting sources based on their 'order' attribute.

methods.name: getConnector
methods.description: Retrieve connector data by ID.

methods.name: eapmEnabled
methods.description: Check if external accounts are enabled for a specific connector ID.

methods.name: getSearchDefs
methods.description: Load or generate search definitions for connectors.

methods.name: getViewDefs
methods.description: Retrieve or generate the view definitions used for merging connector data into the module views.

methods.name: getMergeViewDefs
methods.description: Deprecated method; retrieves or generates merge view definitions for connectors.

methods.name: getConnectors
methods.description: Retrieve all defined connectors, with optional refresh.

methods.name: saveConnectors
methods.description: Persist connector array data to a PHP file.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Scan a directory to find and load source configuration files, returning source entries.

methods.name: getDisplayConfig
methods.description: Load or generate the display configuration mapping modules to sources.

methods.name: getModuleConnectors
methods.description: Retrieve connectors associated with a specific module.

methods.name: isModuleEnabled
methods.description: Check if a module is enabled to be serviced by connectors.

methods.name: isSourceEnabled
methods.description: Determine if a source ID is enabled for at least one module.

methods.name: cleanMetaDataFile
methods.description: Remove connector-related entries from module metadata and refresh the metadata file and cache.

methods.name: updateMetaDataFiles
methods.description: Rebuild metadata files for modules based on display configuration and connector settings.

methods.name: removeHoverField
methods.description: Remove connector hover fields from module detail view definitions.

methods.name: setHoverField
methods.description: Insert or update a connector hover field in module detail view definitions.

methods.name: setDefaultHoverField
methods.description: Set the hover field to the first available field in the module detail view.

methods.name: getConnectorButtonScript
methods.description: Generate HTML code for the connector button/link in the detail view.

methods.name: getConnectorStrings
methods.description: Load language strings for a specific connector source.

methods.name: setConnectorStrings
methods.description: Save language strings for a specific connector source.

methods.name: installSource
methods.description: Add a new connector source to the system and update configuration files.

methods.name: uninstallSource
methods.description: Remove a connector source from the system and update configuration files.

methods.name: hasWizardSourceEnabledForModule
methods.description: Check if at least one connector source is enabled for a module and configured for wizard usage.
